About DFSA
Dragon Fruit Africa (DFSA) focuses on expanding the dragon fruit (pitaya) industry in South Africa and across Africa through high-quality planting material, grower training, technical support and market access services.
DFSA began as a small nursery and became one of the first professional dragon fruit nurseries in Africa, helping many local and international farmers establish commercial dragon fruit farms.

What We Do
DFSA and the broader Dragon Fruit Association of Africa support growers in South Africa and neighbouring countries with complete production guidelines, business planning and access to buyers.
Technical Support & Farm Establishment
Assistance with site selection, trellising systems, irrigation design and full 5-year production plans for new and existing dragon fruit farms (1–5 ha and larger).
Detailed guidelines on water use, fertilisation programmes, pest and disease management and post-harvest handling.
Plant Material Supply & Certification
Supply of premium, often self-pollinating dragon fruit varieties (Ruby, Purple Haze, Zamorano, Sweet White, Gold Israel and others) with variety certificates.
Plants are treated and prepared to high phytosanitary standards before dispatch for local and export markets.
Grower Platform, Forum & Market Linkages
DFSA membership platform and free forum where farmers share cultivation practices, export statistics, pest and disease experience and business tips.
Platform for free advertising, linking dragon fruit farmers with potential buyers.
Association Membership Benefits
Technical guidance from planting through harvest, farm visits, disease diagnosis and treatment recommendations.
Access to both organic and conventional crop-protection inputs.
Our History & Impact
DFSA dates back to 2008 and is described as the first organisation to import dragon fruit planting material into Africa, working with universities on cultivar, pest and disease research. It has helped grow the South African industry from a niche crop to hundreds of hectares under production.

Founder & Lead Expert
Max van Heerden
Leading Technical & Commercial Specialist
Max van Heerden is the leading technical and commercial specialist behind Dragon Fruit South Africa and the Dragon Fruit Association of Africa.
Recognised as the first to import dragon fruit plants into Africa (from 2008), he has supported farms and youth projects across the continent.
He appears in public training videos and seminars under the DFSA / Healthy Fields / Wonderful Dragonfruit banner, explaining cultivars, production methods and market opportunities.

Youth Development & Training
Empowering the next generation of African farmers through comprehensive training and support programmes across the continent.
Youth Farms Established
DFSA has established numerous youth farms for upcoming dragon fruit farmers, providing training and creating employment opportunities in agriculture.
Training Programmes
Youth projects in KwaZulu-Natal and other provinces train young people to produce fresh dragon fruit, dried fruit and value-added products such as dragon-fruit flower honey.
Training Centre & Outgrower Scheme
Dragon Fruit Farming Training Centre & Outgrower Scheme projects in South Africa and Zambia aim to create training hubs and outgrower networks across SADC.
Smallholder Support

What is your success rate?
We maintain a 95%+ success rate. Any cuttings that fail to root are replaced at no charge or refunded.
Do you offer nationwide delivery?
Yes, we deliver rooted plants throughout South Africa and export to select African countries with proper documentation.
Can you root rare varieties?
Absolutely! We specialize in rare and exotic varieties. Some may require additional time or have adjusted pricing.

About Living Culture Health South Africa
Living Culture Health South Africa (Living Culture Health South Africa) is a premium supplier of live probiotic cultures, fermentation starters, superfoods and bio-fertilizers — serving homes, clinics, and farms across South Africa and worldwide.
Founded by Max van Heerden under the Living Culture Health South Africa banner, we've grown from a small operation into a trusted source of natural wellness products, helping thousands of families and practitioners embrace the power of fermented foods and probiotics.

What We Do
We supply premium live cultures, fermentation starters, superfoods, and bio-fertilizers to homes, clinics, and farms across South Africa, SADC, and worldwide.
Live Probiotic Cultures
Premium kefir grains (milk & water), kombucha SCOBYs, yogurt starters, sourdough cultures, and vinegar mothers — all guaranteed alive and active.
Every culture is grown in-house and shipped fresh for maximum potency and viability.
Fermentation Supplies & Education
Complete fermentation starter kits, brewing equipment, and step-by-step guides for beginners and experienced fermenters alike.
Recipes, troubleshooting support, and WhatsApp guidance included with every order.
Superfoods & Algae Cultures
Live spirulina and chlorella cultures, wheatgrass seeds, and nutrient-dense superfoods for health-conscious individuals and practitioners.
Ideal for smoothies, supplements, and professional health practices.
EM1 Bio-Fertilizers & Farming
Effective Microorganisms (EM1), BioSoil, BioPond, and organic growing inputs for sustainable agriculture, aquaponics, and regenerative farming.
Used by farmers across South Africa for soil health, composting, and crop yields.
Our History & Impact
From humble beginnings in 2008, Living Culture Health South Africa has grown into one of South Africa's most trusted suppliers of live cultures, fermentation starters, and natural wellness products — now serving customers across Africa and worldwide.

Wonderful Dragon Fruit South Africa (DFSA) focuses on expanding the dragon fruit (pitaya) industry in South Africa and across Africa through high-quality planting material, grower training, technical support and market access services.

Detailed guidelines on water use, fertilisation programmes, pest and disease management and post-harvest handling.
Plant Material Supply & Certification
Supply of premium, often self-pollinating dragon fruit varieties (Ruby, Purple Haze, Zamorano, Sweet White, Gold Israel and others) with variety certificates.
Plants are treated and prepared to high phytosanitary standards before dispatch for local and export markets.
Grower Platform, Forum & Market Linkages

Association Membership Benefits
Technical guidance from planting through harvest, farm visits, disease diagnosis and treatment recommendations.
Access to both organic and conventional crop-protection inputs.
Our History & Impact
DFSA dates back to 2008 and is described as the first organisation to import dragon fruit planting material into Africa, working with universities on cultivar, pest and disease research. It has helped grow the South African industry from a niche crop to hundreds of hectares under production.
